doc.description: Traffic information keeps a local table of other aircraft seen through supported PPRZLink messages. Load this module when navigation, formation, TCAS, or another feature needs nearby aircraft state. The traditional mode is the default: it accepts ACINFO, ACINFO_LLA, GPS_SMALL, GPS, GPS_LLA, and GPS_INT. Existing airframes need no changes and retain the original traffic_info behavior when mesh is disabled. NB_ACS sets the record count and must not exceed 255; aircraft AC_ID values are limited to 1 through 254. Legacy mode keeps master's table-full behavior; mesh mode rejects new records but keeps known aircraft current. Set TRAFFIC_INFO_USE_LOG to TRUE only when traffic logging is required. Set TRAFFIC_INFO_USE_MESH to TRUE to add compact MESH_STATE reception and self-organising TDMA transmission. Mesh mode is intended for low-bandwidth broadcast radios such as the EByte E52 LoRa mesh family. It requires a telemetry profile containing MESH_STATE and identical TDMA constants on every mesh peer. The periodic mesh task runs at 20 Hz, retains the GPS epoch during bounded holdover, and uses low-rate randomized access when no safe network clock remains. Modem-cache back-pressure limits new state traffic before a five-frame E52 transmit cache can overflow. Mesh mode changes state transport only; the normal traffic table and public access functions stay available. See doc/mesh/mesh_network_design.md before changing timing, slot count, radio settings, or fleet size.

define.name: TRAFFIC_INFO_USE_MESH
define.description: Enable compact MESH_STATE reception and self-organising TDMA transmission

define.name: NB_ACS
define.description: Size of the tracked aircraft table

define.name: MESH_TDMA_SUPERFRAME_MS
define.description: TDMA superframe in ms; MESH_STATE period is this divided by MESH_TDMA_MAX_REUSE

define.name: MESH_TDMA_NB_SLOTS
define.description: TDMA slots per superframe, including headroom for membership churn

define.name: MESH_TDMA_FAIR_SLOTS
define.description: Physical slots distributed as steady-state fair share; remaining slots absorb churn

define.name: MESH_CLOCK_HOLDOVER_MAX_MS
define.description: Maximum bounded GPS-epoch holdover before asynchronous fallback

define.name: MESH_CLOCK_ACQUIRE_MS
define.description: Continuous valid-GPS interval required before GPS TDMA entry

define.name: MESH_ASYNC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
define.description: Minimum randomized MESH_STATE interval without bounded time

define.name: MESH_ASYNC_MAX_INTERVAL_MS
define.description: Maximum randomized MESH_STATE interval without bounded time

define.name: MESH_ASYNC_PEER_HOLD_MS
define.description: Fleet fallback lease after the latest GPS-denied peer advertisement

define.name: MESH_RECOVERY_EPOCH_FRAMES
define.description: Fixed GPS-frame epoch used to select a common TDMA recovery target

define.name: MESH_RECOVERY_MIN_LEAD_FRAMES
define.description: Minimum recovery-target lead beyond all fallback leases

define.name: MESH_MODEM_DRAIN_MS
define.description: Estimated time for one frame to leave the modem transmit cache

define.name: MESH_CACHE_HIGH_WATER
define.description: Stop handing frames to the modem at this estimated cache depth; hardware limit is 5
